product.title: Aeron Chair
product.description: Ergonomic to the core, Aeron was designed for all types of human bodies, thanks to extensive research of designers Bill Stumpf and Don Chadwick. The Aeron Chair has been the benchmark for ergonomic seating ever since its debut in 1994. Today’s Aeron Chair incorporates 8Z Pellicle for smarter weight distribution, adjustable PostureFit SL for total spinal support, and Harmonic 2 Tilt for balanced recline and natural movement. Aeron is available in six material expressions and three sizes—A, B, and C.
